  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr016_protect_terminal_metric_run()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr016_protect_terminal_metric_run()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF OLD.run_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'COMPLETED_WITH_WARNINGS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')<br>       AND NEW.run_status &lt;&gt; OLD.run_status THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'Terminal MetricEvaluationRun outcome cannot be changed or reopened'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>
- `trg_hmr016_metric_run_version_period`: CREATE TRIGGER trg_hmr016_metric_run_version_period BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF metric_definition_version_id, period_start, period_end ON hidra_analytics_metric_evaluation_run FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hmr016_validate_metric_version_period()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr016_validate_metric_version_period()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr016_validate_metric_version_period()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    version_valid_from timestamptz;<br>    version_valid_to timestamptz;<br>BEGIN<br>    SELECT v.valid_from, v.valid_to<br>      INTO version_valid_from, version_valid_to<br>      FROM hidra_analytics_metric_definition_version v<br>     WHERE v.id = NEW.metric_definition_version_id;<br><br>    IF NOT FOUND THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'MetricEvaluationRun metric definition version must exist: %',<br>            NEW.metric_definition_version_id<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF version_valid_from IS NOT NULL AND NEW.period_start &lt; version_valid_from THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'MetricEvaluationRun period starts before metric definition version validity'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF version_valid_to IS NOT NULL AND NEW.period_end &gt; version_valid_to THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'MetricEvaluationRun period ends after metric definition version validity'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr011_require_active_identity_permission()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NEW.permission_id IS NOT NULL<br>       AND NEW.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>       AND NOT EXISTS (<br>           SELECT 1<br>           FROM hidra_identity_permission p<br>           WHERE p.id = NEW.permission_id<br>             AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'Active authorization grant/mapping requires an ACTIVE Permission: %',<br>            NEW.permission_id<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr011_require_active_identity_permission()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NEW.permission_id IS NOT NULL<br>       AND NEW.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>       AND NOT EXISTS (<br>           SELECT 1<br>           FROM hidra_identity_permission p<br>           WHERE p.id = NEW.permission_id<br>             AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'Active authorization grant/mapping requires an ACTIVE Permission: %',<br>            NEW.permission_id<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>

  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hidra_incident_closed_immutable()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hidra_incident_closed_immutable()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF OLD.status='CLOSED' AND (TG_OP='DELETE' OR NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Closed Incident is immutable'; END IF;<br>    IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>
- `tr_hmr062_incident_catalog`: CREATE TRIGGER tr_hmr062_incident_catalog BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON hidra_incident FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hidra_incident_catalog_guard('classification_id', 'INCIDENT_CLASSIFICATION', 'severity_id', 'INCIDENT_SEVERITY', 'priority_id', 'INCIDENT_PRIORITY')
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hidra_incident_catalog_guard()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hidra_incident_catalog_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE v text; previous text; family text; i integer; row_active boolean;<br>BEGIN<br>    FOR i IN 0..(TG_NARGS / 2 - 1) LOOP<br>        v := to_jsonb(NEW)-&gt;&gt;TG_ARGV[i*2]; family := TG_ARGV[i*2+1];<br>        IF v IS NOT NULL THEN<br>            SELECT c.active INTO row_active FROM hidra_incident_catalog_entry c WHERE c.id=v AND c.catalog_name=family FOR SHARE;<br>            IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Incident catalog reference % must belong to %',v,family; END IF;<br>            previous := CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD)-&gt;&gt;TG_ARGV[i*2] ELSE NULL END;<br>            IF (TG_OP='INSERT' OR previous IS DISTINCT FROM v) AND NOT row_active THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Incident catalog reference % must be active',v; END IF;<br>        END IF;<br>    END LOOP;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>
- `tr_hmr090_no_truncate`: CREATE TRIGGER tr_hmr090_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON hidra_incident FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION hidra_incident_evidence_no_truncate()

- `tr_hmr090_parent_consistency`: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER tr_hmr090_parent_consistency AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON hidra_incident DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hidra_incident_closure_deferred()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hidra_incident_closure_deferred()"}

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hidra_incident_catalog_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE v text; previous text; family text; i integer; row_active boolean;<br>BEGIN<br>    FOR i IN 0..(TG_NARGS / 2 - 1) LOOP<br>        v := to_jsonb(NEW)-&gt;&gt;TG_ARGV[i*2]; family := TG_ARGV[i*2+1];<br>        IF v IS NOT NULL THEN<br>            SELECT c.active INTO row_active FROM hidra_incident_catalog_entry c WHERE c.id=v AND c.catalog_name=family FOR SHARE;<br>            IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Incident catalog reference % must belong to %',v,family; END IF;<br>            previous := CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD)-&gt;&gt;TG_ARGV[i*2] ELSE NULL END;<br>            IF (TG_OP='INSERT' OR previous IS DISTINCT FROM v) AND NOT row_active THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Incident catalog reference % must be active',v; END IF;<br>        END IF;<br>    END LOOP;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

#### Triggers

- `trg_hmr015_leak_candidate_provenance`: CREATE TRIGGER trg_hmr015_leak_candidate_provenance BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF profile_id, run_id ON hidra_leak_detection_candidate FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hmr015_validate_leak_candidate_provenance()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr015_validate_leak_candidate_provenance()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr015_validate_leak_candidate_provenance()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    profile_status varchar(40);<br>    run_profile_id varchar(80);<br>    run_status varchar(40);<br>BEGIN<br>    SELECT p.status<br>      INTO profile_status<br>      FROM hidra_leak_detection_profile p<br>     WHERE p.id = NEW.profile_id;<br><br>    IF profile_status IS NULL OR profile_status &lt;&gt; 'ACTIVE' THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'LeakCandidate creation requires an ACTIVE LeakDetectionProfile: %',<br>            NEW.profile_id<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NEW.run_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>        SELECT r.profile_id, r.status<br>          INTO run_profile_id, run_status<br>          FROM hidra_leak_detection_run r<br>         WHERE r.id = NEW.run_id;<br><br>        IF run_profile_id IS NULL THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION<br>                'LeakCandidate run must reference an existing LeakDetectionRun: %',<br>                NEW.run_id<br>                USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br><br>        IF run_profile_id &lt;&gt; NEW.profile_id THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION<br>                'LeakCandidate run and profile provenance must match'<br>                USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br><br>        IF run_status NOT IN ('RUNNING', 'COMPLETED') THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION<br>                'LeakCandidate run must be RUNNING or COMPLETED'<br>                USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>

#### Triggers

- `trg_hmr012_notification_message_template_selection`: CREATE TRIGGER trg_hmr012_notification_message_template_selection BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF template_id, template_version_id ON hidra_notification_message FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hmr012_validate_template_selection()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr012_validate_template_selection()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr012_validate_template_selection()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NEW.template_id IS NULL THEN<br>        IF NEW.template_version_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'template_version_id requires template_id'<br>                USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>        RETURN NEW;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NOT EXISTS (<br>        SELECT 1<br>        FROM hidra_notification_template t<br>        WHERE t.id = NEW.template_id<br>          AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>    ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'New notification generation requires an ACTIVE template: %',<br>            NEW.template_id USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'hidra_notification_message'<br>       AND NEW.template_version_id IS NULL THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'A message using a template must reference the exact template version'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NEW.template_version_id IS NOT NULL<br>       AND NOT EXISTS (<br>           SELECT 1<br>           FROM hidra_notification_template_version v<br>           WHERE v.id = NEW.template_version_id<br>             AND v.template_id = NEW.template_id<br>             AND v.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'template_version_id must identify an ACTIVE version belonging to template_id'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>
- `trg_hmr052_message`: CREATE TRIGGER trg_hmr052_message BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON hidra_notification_message FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hmr052_guard_message()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr052_guard_message()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr052_guard_message()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NOT hmr052_message_valid(NEW.id, NEW.request_id, NEW.recipient_id,<br>            NEW.template_id, NEW.template_version_id, NEW.priority_id, NEW.status) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-052 invalid message composition or required rendering variables'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status &lt;&gt; 'DRAFT' AND NEW.status = 'DRAFT' THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-052 a promoted message cannot revert to DRAFT' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    -- Retain the exact rendering identity after it has become sendable.<br>    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status &lt;&gt; 'DRAFT'<br>       AND (NEW.template_id, NEW.template_version_id) IS DISTINCT FROM<br>           (OLD.template_id, OLD.template_version_id) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-052 rendering version is immutable after DRAFT' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr052_guard_variables()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE parent_id text; parent_status text;<br>BEGIN<br>    FOR parent_id IN<br>        SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest(ARRAY[<br>            CASE WHEN TG_OP &lt;&gt; 'INSERT' THEN OLD.message_id END,<br>            CASE WHEN TG_OP &lt;&gt; 'DELETE' THEN NEW.message_id END]) AS ids(id)<br>        WHERE id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id<br>    LOOP<br>        SELECT status INTO parent_status FROM hidra_notification_message<br>            WHERE id = parent_id FOR UPDATE;<br>        IF FOUND AND parent_status &lt;&gt; 'DRAFT' THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-052 message variables are immutable after DRAFT' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>    END LOOP;<br>    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

- `trg_hmr012_notification_request_template_selection`: CREATE TRIGGER trg_hmr012_notification_request_template_selection BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF template_id, template_version_id ON hidra_notification_request FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hmr012_validate_template_selection()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr012_validate_template_selection()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr012_validate_template_selection()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NEW.template_id IS NULL THEN<br>        IF NEW.template_version_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'template_version_id requires template_id'<br>                USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>        RETURN NEW;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NOT EXISTS (<br>        SELECT 1<br>        FROM hidra_notification_template t<br>        WHERE t.id = NEW.template_id<br>          AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>    ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'New notification generation requires an ACTIVE template: %',<br>            NEW.template_id USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'hidra_notification_message'<br>       AND NEW.template_version_id IS NULL THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'A message using a template must reference the exact template version'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NEW.template_version_id IS NOT NULL<br>       AND NOT EXISTS (<br>           SELECT 1<br>           FROM hidra_notification_template_version v<br>           WHERE v.id = NEW.template_version_id<br>             AND v.template_id = NEW.template_id<br>             AND v.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'template_version_id must identify an ACTIVE version belonging to template_id'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>
- `trg_hmr035_guard_notification_request_catalogs`: CREATE TRIGGER trg_hmr035_guard_notification_request_catalogs BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF category_id, priority_id ON hidra_notification_request FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hmr035_guard_notification_request_catalogs()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr035_guard_notification_request_catalogs()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr035_guard_notification_request_catalogs()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NOT EXISTS (<br>        SELECT 1<br>        FROM hidra_notification_catalog_entry category<br>        WHERE category.id = NEW.category_id<br>          AND category.catalog_name = 'NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY'<br>    ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'NotificationRequest category_id must resolve to NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY: %',<br>            NEW.category_id<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NEW.priority_id IS NOT NULL<br>       AND NOT EXISTS (<br>           SELECT 1<br>           FROM hidra_notification_catalog_entry priority<br>           WHERE priority.id = NEW.priority_id<br>             AND priority.catalog_name = 'NOTIFICATION_PRIORITY'<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'NotificationRequest priority_id must resolve to NOTIFICATION_PRIORITY: %',<br>            NEW.priority_id<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr052_guard_version_evidence()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RETIRED') AND NEW.status = 'DRAFT' THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-052 activated version cannot revert to DRAFT' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    IF OLD.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RETIRED') OR EXISTS (<br>        SELECT 1 FROM hidra_notification_message WHERE template_version_id = OLD.id) THEN<br>        IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-052 referenced or activated rendering version cannot be deleted' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>        IF (NEW.id, NEW.template_id, NEW.version_number, NEW.subject_template, NEW.body_template,<br>            NEW.content_format, NEW.variable_schema_json) IS DISTINCT FROM<br>           (OLD.id, OLD.template_id, OLD.version_number, OLD.subject_template, OLD.body_template,<br>            OLD.content_format, OLD.variable_schema_json) THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-052 rendering version content is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>    END IF;<br>    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr032_guard_organization_unit()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    validate_type boolean := false;<br>BEGIN<br>    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN<br>        validate_type := true;<br>    ELSIF NEW.unit_type_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.unit_type_id THEN<br>        validate_type := true;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF validate_type<br>       AND NOT EXISTS (<br>           SELECT 1<br>           FROM hidra_org_unit_type unit_type<br>           WHERE unit_type.id = NEW.unit_type_id<br>             AND unit_type.active = true<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'OrganizationUnit unit_type_id must resolve to an active selectable type: %',<br>            NEW.unit_type_id<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NEW.parent_unit_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>        IF NEW.parent_unit_id = NEW.id THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION<br>                'OrganizationUnit cannot be its own parent'<br>                USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br><br>        IF EXISTS (<br>            WITH RECURSIVE ancestry(id, parent_unit_id, path, cycle) AS (<br>                SELECT<br>                    parent.id,<br>                    parent.parent_unit_id,<br>                    ARRAY[parent.id]::varchar[],<br>                    false<br>                FROM hidra_org_unit parent<br>                WHERE parent.id = NEW.parent_unit_id<br><br>                UNION ALL<br><br>                SELECT<br>                    parent.id,<br>                    parent.parent_unit_id,<br>                    ancestry.path &#124;&#124; parent.id,<br>                    parent.id = ANY(ancestry.path)<br>                FROM ancestry<br>                JOIN hidra_org_unit parent<br>                  ON parent.id = ancestry.parent_unit_id<br>                WHERE ancestry.parent_unit_id IS NOT NULL<br>                  AND NOT ancestry.cycle<br>            )<br>            SELECT 1<br>            FROM ancestry<br>            WHERE id = NEW.id<br>               OR cycle = true<br>        ) THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION<br>                'OrganizationUnit hierarchy must not contain cycles'<br>                USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>

  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr064_revision_truncate_guard()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr064_revision_truncate_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidra_planning_plan_revision WHERE status='APPROVED') THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-064: cannot truncate approved revisions';<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NULL;<br>END $function$<br>
- `tr_hmr064_revision_write`: CREATE TRIGGER tr_hmr064_revision_write BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON hidra_planning_plan_revision FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hmr064_revision_write_guard()

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr064_revision_write_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN<br>        IF OLD.status = 'APPROVED' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-064: approved revision is immutable'; END IF;<br>        RETURN OLD;<br>    END IF;<br>    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN<br>        IF OLD.status = 'APPROVED' AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-064: approved revision is immutable';<br>        END IF;<br>    END IF;<br>    IF NEW.change_reason_code_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (<br>        SELECT 1 FROM hidra_planning_catalog_entry WHERE id=NEW.change_reason_code_id<br>        AND catalog_name='REVISION_REASON' AND active) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-064: active REVISION_REASON entry required';<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

- `tr_hmr094_target_write`: CREATE TRIGGER tr_hmr094_target_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON hidra_planning_plan_target FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hmr094_target_write_guard()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr094_target_write_guard()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr094_target_write_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    family varchar(80); catalog_active boolean; policy_active boolean; representation varchar(16);<br>    unchanged boolean := false;<br>BEGIN<br>    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN<br>        unchanged := ROW(NEW.target_type_id,NEW.target_value,NEW.target_text_value,NEW.unit_id)<br>            IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.target_type_id,OLD.target_value,OLD.target_text_value,OLD.unit_id);<br>    END IF;<br>    SELECT catalog_name,active INTO family,catalog_active<br>        FROM hidra_planning_catalog_entry WHERE id=NEW.target_type_id FOR SHARE;<br>    SELECT representation_kind,active INTO representation,policy_active<br>        FROM hidra_planning_target_value_policy WHERE target_type_id=NEW.target_type_id FOR SHARE;<br>    IF family IS DISTINCT FROM 'TARGET_TYPE' OR representation IS NULL THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-094: exact TARGET_TYPE and approved value policy required';<br>    END IF;<br>    IF NOT unchanged AND (NOT catalog_active OR NOT policy_active) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-094: fresh value semantics require active catalog/policy';<br>    END IF;<br>    IF (representation='NUMERIC' AND (NEW.target_value IS NULL OR nullif(btrim(NEW.unit_id),'') IS NULL))<br>        OR (representation='TEXT' AND nullif(btrim(NEW.target_text_value),'') IS NULL) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-094: target representation is incomplete';<br>    END IF;<br>    -- Composite local FKs enforce nullable nomination/scenario revision compatibility, including races.<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr013_validate_report_definition()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br>    IF NOT EXISTS (<br>        SELECT 1<br>        FROM hidra_reporting_catalog_entry c<br>        WHERE c.id = NEW.report_category_id<br>          AND c.catalog_name = 'REPORT_CATEGORY'<br>          AND c.active = TRUE<br>    ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'ReportDefinition report_category_id must reference an ACTIVE REPORT_CATEGORY entry: %',<br>            NEW.report_category_id<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NEW.current_template_version_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>        IF NOT EXISTS (<br>            SELECT 1<br>            FROM hidra_reporting_report_template_version v<br>            JOIN hidra_reporting_report_template t<br>              ON t.id = v.report_template_id<br>            WHERE v.id = NEW.current_template_version_id<br>              AND t.report_definition_id = NEW.id<br>              AND (<br>                  NEW.status &lt;&gt; 'ACTIVE'<br>                  OR (v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.active = TRUE)<br>              )<br>        ) THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION<br>                'ReportDefinition current template version must belong to the definition and satisfy lifecycle eligibility'<br>                USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NEW.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>       AND NEW.restricted = TRUE<br>       AND NOT EXISTS (<br>           SELECT 1<br>           FROM hidra_reporting_access_policy p<br>           WHERE p.report_definition_id = NEW.id<br>             AND p.restricted = TRUE<br>             AND btrim(p.permission_code) &lt;&gt; ''<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'ACTIVE restricted ReportDefinition requires an explicit Reporting access policy'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>

d record;<br>BEGIN<br>    SELECT t.report_definition_id INTO template_definition<br>    FROM hidra_reporting_report_template_version v JOIN hidra_reporting_report_template t ON t.id=v.report_template_id<br>    WHERE v.id=NEW.template_version_id FOR SHARE OF v,t;<br>    IF template_definition IS NULL OR template_definition&lt;&gt;NEW.report_definition_id THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ReportRun template lineage must match definition' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;<br>    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND ROW(NEW.report_request_id,NEW.report_definition_id,NEW.template_version_id)<br>        IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.report_request_id,OLD.report_definition_id,OLD.template_version_id)<br>        AND NOT (NEW.status='QUEUED' AND OLD.status&lt;&gt;'QUEUED') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;<br>    SELECT status INTO request_status FROM hidra_reporting_request WHERE id=NEW.report_request_id FOR SHARE;<br>    IF request_status NOT IN ('SUBMITTED','APPROVED') OR request_status IS NULL THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ReportRequest is not eligible for new queue' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;<br>    FOR d IN SELECT * FROM hidra_reporting_parameter_definition<br>        WHERE report_definition_id=NEW.report_definition_id AND active AND required FOR SHARE LOOP<br>        IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_reporting_parameter_value v<br>            WHERE v.report_request_id=NEW.report_request_id AND v.parameter_definition_id=d.id AND v.parameter_code=d.code<br>            AND num_nonnulls(v.value_text,v.value_number,v.value_boolean,v.value_date,v.value_date_time,v.value_json)=1<br>            AND CASE v.value_type<br>                WHEN 'TEXT' THEN v.value_text IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(v.value_text))&gt;0<br>                WHEN 'REFERENCE' THEN v.value_text IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(v.value_text))&gt;0<br>                WHEN 'NUMBER' THEN v.value_number IS NOT NULL<br>                WHEN 'BOOLEAN' THEN v.value_boolean IS NOT NULL<br>                WHEN 'DATE' THEN v.value_date IS NOT NULL<br>                WHEN 'DATE_TIME' THEN v.value_date_time IS NOT NULL<br>                WHEN 'JSON' THEN v.value_json IS NOT NULL<br>                ELSE FALSE END)<br>        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Required concrete parameter missing or invalid: %',d.code USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;<br>    END LOOP;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

END IF;<br>    SELECT *<br>      INTO request_row<br>      FROM hidra_reporting_request r<br>     WHERE r.id = NEW.report_request_id;<br><br>    IF request_row.id IS NULL THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ReportRun report_request_id must reference an existing ReportRequest: %',<br>            NEW.report_request_id USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF request_row.report_definition_id &lt;&gt; NEW.report_definition_id THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ReportRun definition must match its ReportRequest definition'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    SELECT *<br>      INTO definition_row<br>      FROM hidra_reporting_report_definition d<br>     WHERE d.id = NEW.report_definition_id;<br><br>    IF definition_row.status &lt;&gt; 'ACTIVE' THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Queued ReportRun requires an ACTIVE ReportDefinition'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF definition_row.restricted = TRUE<br>       AND NOT hmr013_reporting_request_policy_matches(<br>           NEW.report_definition_id,<br>           request_row.requested_by_actor_id,<br>           request_row.requested_by_role_code_snapshot,<br>           request_row.organization_unit_id<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Restricted ReportRun requires an explicit matching Reporting access policy'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF definition_row.requires_approval = TRUE<br>       AND (<br>           request_row.status &lt;&gt; 'APPROVED'<br>           OR request_row.workflow_reference_id IS NULL<br>           OR btrim(request_row.workflow_reference_id) = ''<br>       ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'Approval-required ReportDefinition cannot be queued without APPROVED request state and Workflow reference'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    IF NOT EXISTS (<br>        SELECT 1<br>        FROM hidra_reporting_report_template_version v<br>        JOIN hidra_reporting_report_template t<br>          ON t.id = v.report_template_id<br>        WHERE v.id = NEW.template_version_id<br>          AND v.status = 'ACTIVE'<br>          AND t.active = TRUE<br>          AND t.report_definition_id = NEW.report_definition_id<br>    ) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION<br>            'ReportRun template_version_id must be an ACTIVE version belonging to the selected definition'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br><br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END;<br>$function$<br>

a hidra_risk_assessment%ROWTYPE;<br>    provenance hidra_risk_assessment_scoring%ROWTYPE; cell hidra_risk_matrix_cell%ROWTYPE; version text;<br>BEGIN<br>    IF TG_OP&lt;&gt;'INSERT' THEN old_parent=COALESCE(to_jsonb(OLD)-&gt;&gt;'risk_assessment_id',to_jsonb(OLD)-&gt;&gt;'assessment_id',to_jsonb(OLD)-&gt;&gt;'id'); END IF;<br>    IF TG_OP&lt;&gt;'DELETE' THEN new_parent=COALESCE(to_jsonb(NEW)-&gt;&gt;'risk_assessment_id',to_jsonb(NEW)-&gt;&gt;'assessment_id',to_jsonb(NEW)-&gt;&gt;'id'); END IF;<br>    FOR pid IN SELECT DISTINCT p FROM unnest(ARRAY[old_parent,new_parent]) p WHERE p IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p LOOP<br>        SELECT * INTO a FROM hidra_risk_assessment WHERE id=pid FOR UPDATE;<br>        IF NOT FOUND THEN CONTINUE; END IF;<br>        IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_risk_assessment_scope WHERE risk_assessment_id=pid) THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assessment requires at least one scope at commit'; END IF;<br>        SELECT * INTO provenance FROM hidra_risk_assessment_scoring WHERE assessment_id=pid;<br>        IF NOT FOUND THEN<br>            IF a.inherent_likelihood_id IS NOT NULL OR a.inherent_consequence_id IS NOT NULL OR a.inherent_score IS NOT NULL<br>                OR a.inherent_rating_id IS NOT NULL OR a.residual_likelihood_id IS NOT NULL<br>                OR a.residual_consequence_id IS NOT NULL OR a.residual_score IS NOT NULL OR a.residual_rating_id IS NOT NULL<br>            THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Scoring requires explicit matrix-cell provenance'; END IF;<br>            CONTINUE;<br>        END IF;<br>        SELECT * INTO cell FROM hidra_risk_matrix_cell WHERE id=provenance.inherent_cell_id FOR SHARE;<br>        SELECT m.version INTO version FROM hidra_risk_matrix m WHERE id=provenance.inherent_matrix_id FOR SHARE;<br>        IF cell.risk_matrix_id IS DISTINCT FROM provenance.inherent_matrix_id OR version IS DISTINCT FROM provenance.inherent_matrix_version<br>            OR a.inherent_likelihood_id IS DISTINCT FROM cell.likelihood_level_id<br>            OR a.inherent_consequence_id IS DISTINCT FROM cell.consequence_level_id<br>            OR a.inherent_score IS DISTINCT FROM cell.score_value OR a.inherent_rating_id IS DISTINCT FROM cell.rating_id<br>        THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Inherent scoring tuple must match selected cell and matrix version'; END IF;<br>        IF provenance.residual_cell_id IS NULL THEN<br>            IF a.residual_likelihood_id IS NOT NULL OR a.residual_consequence_id IS NOT NULL OR a.residual_score IS NOT NULL OR a.residual_rating_id IS NOT NULL<br>            THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Residual tuple requires explicit residual provenance'; END IF;<br>        ELSE<br>            SELECT * INTO cell FROM hidra_risk_matrix_cell WHERE id=provenance.residual_cell_id FOR SHARE;<br>            SELECT m.version INTO version FROM hidra_risk_matrix m WHERE id=provenance.residual_matrix_id FOR SHARE;<br>            IF cell.risk_matrix_id IS DISTINCT FROM provenance.residual_matrix_id OR version IS DISTINCT FROM provenance.residual_matrix_version<br>                OR a.residual_likelihood_id IS DISTINCT FROM cell.likelihood_level_id<br>                OR a.residual_consequence_id IS DISTINCT FROM cell.consequence_level_id<br>                OR a.residual_score IS DISTINCT FROM cell.score_value OR a.residual_rating_id IS DISTINCT FROM cell.rating_id<br>            THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Residual scoring tuple must match selected cell and matrix version'; END IF;<br>            IF provenance.residual_context_type='CONTROL' THEN<br>                PERFORM id FROM hidra_risk_control WHERE id=provenance.residual_context_id AND risk_assessment_id=pid FOR SHARE;<br>            ELSE<br>                PERFORM id FROM hidra_risk_treatment_plan WHERE id=provenance.residual_context_id AND risk_assessment_id=pid FOR SHARE;<br>            END IF;<br>            IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Residual context must belong to the same assessment'; END IF;<br>        END IF;<br>    END LOOP;<br>    RETURN NULL;<br>END $function$<br>

  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr079_validate_recommendation_catalogs()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr079_validate_recommendation_catalogs()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE t hidra_simulation_catalog_entry%ROWTYPE; c hidra_simulation_catalog_entry%ROWTYPE;<br>    type_active boolean := true; confidence_active boolean := true;<br>BEGIN<br>    IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN<br>        type_active := NEW.recommendation_type_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.recommendation_type_id;<br>        confidence_active := NEW.confidence_level_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.confidence_level_id;<br>    END IF;<br>    SELECT * INTO t FROM hidra_simulation_catalog_entry WHERE id=NEW.recommendation_type_id FOR SHARE;<br>    IF t.id IS NULL OR t.catalog_name&lt;&gt;'SIMULATION_RECOMMENDATION_TYPE' OR (type_active AND NOT t.active) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recommendation requires eligible SIMULATION_RECOMMENDATION_TYPE' USING ERRCODE='23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    IF NEW.confidence_level_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>        SELECT * INTO c FROM hidra_simulation_catalog_entry WHERE id=NEW.confidence_level_id FOR SHARE;<br>        IF c.id IS NULL OR c.catalog_name&lt;&gt;'SIMULATION_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL' OR (confidence_active AND NOT c.active) THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recommendation requires eligible SIMULATION_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL' USING ERRCODE='23514';<br>        END IF;<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hmr053_guard_trusted_creation()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hmr053_guard_trusted_creation()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE<br>    v_raw hidra_telemetry_reading%ROWTYPE;<br>    v_point hidra_telemetry_point%ROWTYPE;<br>    v_assessment hidra_telemetry_quality_assessment%ROWTYPE;<br>    v_has_binding boolean;<br>BEGIN<br>    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN<br>        IF NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 trusted evidence and binding snapshots cannot be rewritten' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>        RETURN NEW; -- No-op saves do not re-evaluate historical eligibility against today's state.<br>    END IF;<br>    SELECT * INTO v_raw FROM hidra_telemetry_reading WHERE id = NEW.reading_id FOR SHARE;<br>    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 missing raw reading' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;<br>    SELECT * INTO v_point FROM hidra_telemetry_point WHERE id = NEW.point_id FOR SHARE;<br>    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 missing point' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;<br>    SELECT * INTO v_assessment FROM hidra_telemetry_quality_assessment WHERE id = NEW.quality_assessment_id FOR SHARE;<br>    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 missing assessment' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;<br>    IF v_point.status &lt;&gt; 'ACTIVE' OR v_assessment.assessment_status &lt;&gt; 'PASSED'<br>       OR v_assessment.trust_level NOT IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CERTIFIED')<br>       OR NEW.point_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_raw.point_id<br>       OR (NEW.reading_id, NEW.point_id, NEW.quality_code_id, NEW.trust_level) IS DISTINCT FROM<br>          (v_assessment.reading_id, v_assessment.point_id, v_assessment.resolved_quality_code_id, v_assessment.trust_level) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 requires consistent PASSED assessment, acceptable trust and ACTIVE point'<br>            USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    PERFORM 1 FROM hidra_telemetry_type_catalog c<br>        WHERE c.id = NEW.quality_code_id AND c.catalog_name = 'QUALITY_CODE' AND c.active FOR SHARE;<br>    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 quality code must be an active QUALITY_CODE' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;<br>    IF NEW.unit_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_point.unit_id OR NEW.ingestion_batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_raw.ingestion_batch_id<br>       OR (NEW.numeric_value, NEW.text_value, NEW.boolean_value, NEW.source_timestamp) IS DISTINCT FROM<br>          (v_raw.numeric_value, v_raw.text_value, v_raw.boolean_value, v_raw.source_timestamp) THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 trusted values and provenance must derive from source evidence' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidra_telemetry_point_binding b<br>                   WHERE b.point_id = NEW.point_id AND b.active AND b.valid_from &lt;= NEW.trusted_at<br>                     AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR NEW.trusted_at &lt; b.valid_to)) INTO v_has_binding;<br>    IF v_has_binding THEN<br>        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hidra_telemetry_point_binding b<br>                       WHERE b.point_id = NEW.point_id AND b.active AND b.valid_from &lt;= NEW.trusted_at<br>                         AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR NEW.trusted_at &lt; b.valid_to)<br>                         AND (b.topology_asset_type_code, b.topology_asset_id, b.topology_asset_code, b.topology_snapshot_id)<br>                             IS NOT DISTINCT FROM<br>                             (NEW.topology_asset_type_code, NEW.topology_asset_id, NEW.topology_asset_code, NEW.topology_snapshot_id)) THEN<br>            RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 topology snapshot must match an applicable active binding' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>        END IF;<br>    ELSIF NEW.topology_asset_type_code IS NOT NULL OR NEW.topology_asset_id IS NOT NULL<br>          OR NEW.topology_asset_code IS NOT NULL OR NEW.topology_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL THEN<br>        RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR-053 no active binding supports the supplied topology snapshot' USING ERRCODE = '23514';<br>    END IF;<br>    RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hidra_hmr055_start_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>BEGIN<br> IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.definition_id,NEW.definition_version,NEW.workflow_purpose_id,NEW.target_module,NEW.target_type_id,NEW.target_id)<br> IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (OLD.definition_id,OLD.definition_version,OLD.workflow_purpose_id,OLD.target_module,OLD.target_type_id,OLD.target_id) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;<br> IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_workflow_definition WHERE id=NEW.definition_id AND version=NEW.definition_version AND status='ACTIVE')<br> OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_workflow_definition_target_binding WHERE definition_id=NEW.definition_id AND target_module=NEW.target_module<br> AND target_type_id=NEW.target_type_id AND workflow_purpose_id=NEW.workflow_purpose_id AND active)<br> OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_workflow_type_catalog WHERE id=NEW.workflow_purpose_id AND catalog_name='WORKFLOW_PURPOSE' AND active)<br> OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_workflow_type_catalog WHERE id=NEW.target_type_id AND catalog_name='WORKFLOW_TARGET_TYPE' AND active)<br> THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR055: ACTIVE definition/version, exact binding and active purpose/target catalogs required'; END IF;<br> RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>

- `tr_hmr066_task`: CREATE TRIGGER tr_hmr066_task BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON hidra_workflow_task FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hidra_hmr066_task_guard()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hidra_hmr066_task_guard()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hidra_hmr066_task_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$<br>DECLARE instance_definition varchar(80);<br>BEGIN<br> IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN<br>  IF OLD.status NOT IN ('OPEN','CLAIMED','IN_REVIEW') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR066: terminal task evidence is immutable'; END IF;<br>  IF (OLD.instance_id,OLD.step_id,OLD.created_at) IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.instance_id,NEW.step_id,NEW.created_at)<br>  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR066: task instance/step/creation cannot be reassigned'; END IF;<br> END IF;<br> SELECT definition_id INTO instance_definition FROM hidra_workflow_instance WHERE id=NEW.instance_id;<br> IF instance_definition IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_workflow_step WHERE id=NEW.step_id AND definition_id=instance_definition)<br> THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR066: task step must belong to instance definition'; END IF;<br> IF NEW.priority_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_workflow_type_catalog WHERE id=NEW.priority_id AND catalog_name='WORKFLOW_PRIORITY' AND active)<br> OR NEW.assignment_mode_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_workflow_type_catalog WHERE id=NEW.assignment_mode_id AND catalog_name='WORKFLOW_ASSIGNMENT_MODE' AND active)<br> THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR066: active task priority/assignment catalogs required'; END IF;<br> RETURN NEW;<br>END $function$<br>
- `tr_hmr066_task_delete`: CREATE TRIGGER tr_hmr066_task_delete BEFORE DELETE ON hidra_workflow_task FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hidra_hmr066_task_delete_guard()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hidra_hmr066_task_delete_guard()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hidra_hmr066_task_delete_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$ BEGIN<br> IF OLD.status NOT IN ('OPEN','CLAIMED','IN_REVIEW') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR066: terminal task evidence cannot be deleted'; END IF;<br> RETURN OLD; END $function$<br>
- `tr_hmr066_task_truncate`: CREATE TRIGGER tr_hmr066_task_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON hidra_workflow_task FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION hidra_hmr066_task_truncate_guard()
  - Catalog attributes: {"enabled": "O", "function_identity": "public.hidra_hmr066_task_truncate_guard()"}
  - Function evidence: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hidra_hmr066_task_truncate_guard()<br> RETURNS trigger<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br>AS $function$ BEGIN<br> IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidra_workflow_task WHERE status NOT IN ('OPEN','CLAIMED','IN_REVIEW'))<br> THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'HMR066: terminal task evidence cannot be truncated'; END IF;<br> RETURN NULL; END $function$<br>
